title: cupressus macrocarpa f. lutea
intro: Cupressus macrocarpa f. lutea, commonly known as the Golden Monkey Puzzle, is a variant of the Monkey Puzzle tree (Cupressus macrocarpa) known for its golden-yellow foliage. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cupressus macrocarpa f. lutea are attributed to its ability to reduce stress, improve sleep quality, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
